stem: Which sentence from the selection best supports the idea that careful adjustments to Three Gorges Dam can improve the quality of the Yangtze River?

options.label: A
options.text: Ickes helped researchers embed transmitters into a small sample of fish in the Yangtze River basin.

options.label: B
options.text: They hope to determine the right amount of water to release from the dam in order to support the natural breeding of the fish.

options.label: C
options.text: The dam is located on the Yangtze River, one of the most important rivers in China, famed for its diverse wildlife.

options.label: D
options.text: Other fish are important for maintaining the fishing industry, a major part of the economy for cities on the river.
